274680638.description: This vintage educational set features a boxed Mineral Specimens collection with 37 labeled minerals and rocks in a compartmentalized display case, including an identification sheet. Included are educational materials: a boxed set of Ed-U-Cards of Nature with cards and descriptions such as 'Apatite', and a vintage Rocks and Minerals: A Golden Nature Guide reference book. Items show signs of age and use but remain in good collectible condition, suitable for educational or display purposes.
